Name: Eat Rocks by fairyfarming
Author: fairyfarming
Description:
this mod lets you eat stone and some minerals. that's it.


special thanks to huskyn1nja for pushing me to create my first mod, and all the lovely people in the modded-stardew channel in the SDV discord.







NOTE: This mod will never support eating amethyst. For that i recommend: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39356]Edible Amethyst[/url] by huskyn1nja

Downloads.Description: updated to add support for all minerals (except for amethyst)
